methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: energy and economic performances of a solar PV powered air conditioning unit (ACU) with a battery system (PBAS) based on numerical and experimental investigations

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Paper is a numerical/experimental performance and techno-economic study of a solar PV-battery-air conditioner system (PBAS) for a single building room. Its indicators (self-consumption, self-sufficiency, grid-independence and energy-conversion ratios) characterise a renewable generation-plus-storage system, not an EnPI/EnB energy-performance measurement model with a relevant-variable-normalised energy baseline. No ISO 50001/50006 or EnPI/EnB model content; building/HVAC context.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The studied PBAS was designed for the thermal management of a single room (single project room), located on the fourth floor of the Ege University Mechanical Engineering Department building

stage1.notes: Borderline hook: paper uses the phrase 'energy performance indicators' and proposes a novel one (grid independence ratio), but these are PV-system energy-flow ratios (SCR/SSR/GIR/conversion), not ISO 50006 EnPI/EnB baselines. Flag for human eligibility check.
